faqs.a: We are based in Guildford and cover Godalming, Woking, Shalford, Bramley, Wonersh and Cranleigh. If you are just outside these areas, send a quote request anyway and we will tell you honestly whether we can help.

faqs.q: How do I get a price?
faqs.a: Fill in the two-minute quote form with your postcode, the type of clean and the size of the property. We will reply with a clear quote and confirm exactly what is included before any work is booked.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a regular clean and a deep clean?
faqs.a: A regular clean keeps a home on top form week to week: kitchens, bathrooms, dusting, floors and tidying. A deep clean is a one-off, top-to-bottom reset that also covers the areas a routine visit does not, such as skirting boards, limescale build-up, behind movable furniture and inside appliances on request.

faqs.q: Do you clean offices and commercial premises?
faqs.a: Yes. We clean offices, studios and small commercial premises, on a schedule agreed with you so cleaning fits around your working day.

faqs.q: Can I choose what is included?
faqs.a: Yes. Every quote starts from our standard checklist, and you can add or remove tasks. Tell us about anything specific, such as inside the oven, inside windows or a particular room, when you request a quote.

faqs.q: Do I need to be at home during the clean?
faqs.a: Not necessarily. Whether you would like to be home or not, we will agree access arrangements with you when we confirm the booking.
